description: This PHP source file defines the I18nPluginConfiguration class which implements plugin configuration for internationalization services within the OrangeHRM system. It registers I18N services and helpers in the service container during initialization.

classes.name: I18nPluginConfiguration
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring internationalization services within the plugin by registering necessary services in the application's service container.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin configuration by registering I18N services and helpers into the service container during a request.
